new: Automatically recover a manually started connection after an unexpected tunnel failure, with three bounded retry attempts.
improved: Enable Auto Recovery by default for new connection profiles while preserving existing preferences. Every new app session still requires manual Connect.
Keep Auto Recovery visible on Connection and provide Disconnect after recovery attempts are exhausted.
fixed: Cancel recovery on Disconnect, app close and update shutdown; prevent preference toggles from resetting the retry budget early.
Require manual reconnection after trusted credential changes and terminate safely if update installation fails after shutdown.
